calls.sql:
SELECT c.region AS region, SUM(o.total) AS total
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY c.region

SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, SUM(o.total) AS total
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 6

GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY c.region

JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id

GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 6

JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 6
